scripts.text:
[Battle Therapist]
Just close your eyes,
and take a deep breath.
You can be free from pain.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥治療師]
閉上眼睛，深呼吸。
疼痛很快就會消失。

Let's enjoy our glorious victory!
{0}, it's a sign reflecting victory.
scripts.translation:
讓我們共享勝利的榮光！
{0}，這是勝利的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Axl Rose]
Blessed Guillaume!
Let's enjoy our glorious victory!
{0}, it's a sign reflecting victory.
scripts.translation:
[阿克塞爾·羅斯]
吉約姆保佑！
讓我們共享勝利的榮光！
{0}，這是勝利的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Swandery]
Blessed Croix!
Let's enjoy our glorious victory!
{0}, it's a sign reflecting victory.
scripts.translation:
[斯萬德里]
克魯瓦保佑！
讓我們共享勝利的榮光！
{0}，這是勝利的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Axl Rose]
You lost, but you're dedicated to this battle.
This is a reward for your great dedication by Guillaume Marollo!
Just take this defeat as a lesson, and next time you will definitely win.
scripts.translation:
[阿克塞爾·羅斯]
你輸了，但仍為這場戰鬥全力以赴。
這是吉約姆·馬洛洛為表彰你付出的努力而送上的獎勵！
把這次失敗當作教訓，下次你一定會贏。

scripts.text:
[Swandery]
Oh, {0} Don't be sad.
Even though we didn't win, we did our best.
This is a Royal gift from Croix, and please don't forget this battle. We will win the next one.
scripts.translation:
[斯萬德里]
哦，{0}，別難過。
雖然我們沒贏，但已經盡力了。
這是克魯瓦王室送給你的禮物，請別忘記這場戰鬥。下次我們一定會贏。
